comments.value: Biggest way to tell the bug just happened and it logged you out is try view someones Profile, it its a huge blank page the bug happened and you are logged out.

details:
Description

This is a major bug with the new Login update broke staying logged in, I have a VPN which keeps me safe from weirdos, but after this update using VRC with a VPN enabled I CANNOT: Be safe, change worlds without randomly being returned to default VRC home world, change avatars, add friends, send/request invites, view peoples profiles, or even mute/block people. This by far has been the most DANGEROUS update to date, women arent safe without the VPN protection. VRC has lots and lots of hackers, doxers, cyberstalkers, crashers, client users, etc. and using VRC without a VPN is making women easy targets, this makes us vulnerable. We NEED VPN protection as we have experienced the worst of the worst people from time to time and they wreck lives for fun, for content, and from the most evil reason "BECAUSE THEY CAN" yes straight words I got from a doxer that did it for no other reason than bc he can. Need the Login Update to be compatible with VPNs asap, It is vital for safety.

Reproduction Steps

Login VRC with a VPN enabled. Stay around more than 20 minutes. When you swap worlds you will see people's avatara are all blank and it might send you straight to Login screen, tell you session has expired or dump you in default VRchat homeworld and force your avatar as an Error Droid.

Details

- Category: Networking

- Frequency: Always
